caller.author: BobLoukas
caller.text:
Bitcoin has to get moving here.  

In any solid uptrend, three red weekly candles typically is a short reset and a quick continuation of the trend resumes.  We need to see that quickly imo.

parent.author: BobLoukas
parent.text:
Bitcoin appears to be confirming the new cycle here. These events provide a really clear and clean setup. 

The upside target is around 30 to 45 days, room for a good advance.  It is however not guarantee of a major upside move, but provides an excellent anchoring point because a loss of the recent lows ($79,600) is a level where you would want to get very defensive.
